props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the viewport. Ignored when `itemRender` is set.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: itemRender
props.description:
Renders one collection item. Takes the place of `children`. It is mounted as a component, so
read `props.item` and `props.index` lazily instead of destructuring them.

props.name: items
props.description: Reactive collection rendered with `itemRender`. Has no effect without `itemRender`.

props.name: onOverflowChange
props.description: Called with the new `Overflow` whenever content starts or stops extending beyond an edge, for example while scrolling or after a resize.

props.name: onScrollBottom
props.description: Called once each time scrolling reaches the bottom edge (within `scrollThreshold`) of an overflowing vertical axis, such as to load more items.

props.name: onScrollLeft
props.description: Called once each time scrolling reaches the left edge (within `scrollThreshold`) of an overflowing horizontal axis; in RTL content that is the logical end.

props.name: onScrollRight
props.description: Called once each time scrolling reaches the right edge (within `scrollThreshold`) of an overflowing horizontal axis; in RTL content that is the logical start.

props.name: onScrollTop
props.description: Called once each time scrolling returns to the top edge (within `scrollThreshold`) of an overflowing vertical axis; not called for the initial position.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Scrollable axes.

props.name: scrollbar
props.description:
Scrollbar presentation. `auto` shows custom scrollbars while an axis overflows, `always` keeps
them visible, `hover` shows them while the pointer is over the area or it scrolls, `scroll`
shows them while it scrolls, `native` keeps browser scrollbars, and `hidden` hides every
scrollbar while retaining scrolling.

props.name: scrollHideDelay
props.description: Milliseconds `hover` and `scroll` scrollbars stay visible after pointer or scroll activity ends. Other scrollbar modes ignore it.

props.name: scrollThreshold
props.description: Distance in pixels from an edge within which it counts as reached. It also decides when the edge shadows and the `onScroll*` callbacks respond. Negative values count as `0`.

props.name: setController
props.description:
Receives the imperative controller once, during setup. Store it and call it later; the viewport
only exists after mount, so `scrollToEdge` called during setup does nothing.
examples:
import { ScrollArea } from 'moraine'
import type { ScrollAreaT } from 'moraine'

let controller: ScrollAreaT.Controller | undefined

<>
  <button onClick={() => controller?.scrollToEdge('y', 'end', { behavior: 'smooth' })}>
    Jump to bottom
  </button>
  <ScrollArea class="h-48" setController={(value) => (controller = value)}>
    Long content
  </ScrollArea>
</>

props.name: shadow
props.description: Whether edges with more content beyond them fade out as a shadow.

props.name: shadowSize
props.description: Length in pixels of the edge fade shadows while the `shadow` variant is enabled. Negative values count as `0`.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: viewportRef
props.description: Receives the native scrolling `<div>` that wraps the content, to read or set `scrollTop` and similar.

props.name: virtualizer
props.description:
Renders only the visible `items`. The viewport is the scroll container; create the
virtualizer with `horizontal` for `orientation="horizontal"`. Requires `itemRender`, and
the row element must spread `props.props` so the virtualizer can position and measure it.
